notes.title: Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition
notes.notes:
We are back once again for the Steam Game Festival (Autumn Edition)! For a limited time, download and play the latest Bot Rods demo and tell us what you think! Your feedback is always appreciated, as we work towards tightening every little screw, nut and bolt. 

Head on over to our Steam page and download today. Don't forget to wishlist us!

Do send us you feedback here: http://www.botrodsthegame.com/beta/feedback/

notes.title: Steam Game Festival: Summer Edition
notes.notes:
Our teams have been working extremely hard to bring you this vision that was kick-started several years ago. And truth be told, we have much more to show you... Which is why next week, for the first time ever, Bot Rods will have a playable demo as part of the Steam Game Festival, Summer Edition from June 16th to 22nd 2020! 

So spread the word, because it's time to Bot, Set, GO!!! 

Here's our first official Bot Rods Gameplay Trailer!

[previewyoutube=BcbrfXPjEZA;full][/previewyoutube]


The demo will feature two playable characters which you can customize, two playable tracks, and two-player split-screen versus!
